title: Ask before doing: agent approval
description: An AI agent stops and asks a person before it runs a risky action, and every step is logged: a plain app window with the approval request (the action as code, its target and reason, Deny and Allow) and the activity log as its bottom pane, under a centred headline, on the light register.

fields.label: Headline
fields.hint: The first point, at the top. One line; about 20 characters.

fields.label: Subhead
fields.hint: The second point, under the headline. One line; about 25 characters.

fields.label: Agent
fields.hint: Who is asking, at the card's top left. A word or two.

fields.label: Status
fields.hint: Next to the agent's name. Two or three words.

fields.label: Badge
fields.hint: The red pill at the card's top right. Three words at most.

fields.label: Request
fields.default: The agent wants to run this action
fields.hint: The card's title, above the code. One line; about 35 characters.

fields.label: Action (code)
fields.hint: The SQL or command the agent wants to run. Two or three short lines; its first line also names the action in the log.

fields.label: Target
fields.hint: What the action touches. A few words.

fields.label: Agent's reason
fields.hint: Why the agent wants to run it. A short phrase.

fields.label: Time
fields.hint: When the request was logged, as HH:MM.
